scripts.dev: npm run build -w @callmind/shared && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:worker" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @callmind/shared && npm run build -w @callmind/db && npm run build -w @callmind/api && npm run build -w @callmind/worker && npm run build -w @callmind/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @callmind/shared && npm run build -w @callmind/db && npm run typecheck -w @callmind/db && npm run typecheck -w @callmind/api && npm run typecheck -w @callmind/worker && npm run typecheck -w @callmind/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @callmind/shared && npm run build -w @callmind/db && npm run test -w @callmind/shared && npm run test -w @callmind/db && npm run test -w @callmind/api && npm run test -w @callmind/worker && npm run test -w @callmind/web
scripts.test:job: docker compose exec worker npm run enqueue:test -w @callmind/worker
